Subject: BrightPath Q3 remittance routing & cost-center mapping

Sara —

Following up from our call earlier: we can support split remittances so a single consolidated invoice hits BrightPath AP while payments route to two legal entities (Redwood US and Redwood EU) with line-level cost-center tags. To move forward we need:

- PO numbers and the AP contact who will receive the test invoice
- Desired cost-center codes for each line item (e.g., R&D-TPX, Sales-APPS)
- For EU remittances: VAT treatment (BrightPath EU VAT ID if applicable) and whether you need a VAT-inclusive invoice

I attached a short CSV template that maps invoice lines to entity, ledger tag, and remittance instructions. If you can return that populated we’ll generate a test invoice (no payment required) and validate the accounting fields with your treasury team.

Attachments:
- redwood_split_template.csv (CSV)

Next steps: if you can send PO and cost-centers by EOD Wed I’ll have accounting produce a test invoice by Fri.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sara Murphy <sara.murphy@brightpathtx.com>

Subject: Re: BrightPath Q3 remittance routing & cost-center mapping

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can do the mapping, and I uploaded the initial PO here (see attachment). A few clarifications before we populate your template:

- Our company is BrightPath Therapeutics, Inc. (US) with a UK subsidiary BrightPath Ltd. For EU spend we will route payments to the UK entity; I can provide the UK VAT ID tomorrow.
- AP prefers consolidated invoice (single PDF) with line-level cost allocations so our ERP can post automatically.
- Payment terms: Net30 is standard for us.

I attached PO BP_PO_7890.pdf and copied our treasury alias. We’ll fill the CSV and return it by Thursday. Can you confirm if Redwood needs separate remittance bank accounts or if you can accept a single ACH with split posting on your side?

Best,

BrightPath Therapeutics
[sara.murphy@brightpathtx.com | +1 214-555-3344]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath Q3 remittance routing & cost-center mapping

Sara —

Short answers to your questions: we prefer a single ACH/wire from the customer (consolidated payment) and do the split posting internally to the two Redwood legal entities. That is the simplest for AP. If BrightPath requires separate bank remittances to each Redwood entity we can support that but will need separate payment references (we can include per-line remittance refs in the invoice).

Plan:
1) You populate the attached CSV with PO line mappings and the UK VAT ID when available.
2) Accounting generates a "test invoice" PDF (invoice number test only) with line-level tags and remittance references. No payment is required for verification.
3) We confirm the file drops your ERP needs (CSV schema) and sign off on cost-center codes.

Ben and Lauren — tagging you to confirm internal routing and note any constraints for posting to Redwood Ltd (UK). In particular, Ben — can you confirm tax invoice wording for EU entries (VAT inclusive vs. separate VAT lines)? Lauren — I believe we need the UK tax ID in our entity mapping table before going live.

Thanks,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath Q3 remittance routing & cost-center mapping

Aditya / Sara —

Confirmed — Redwood can accept consolidated payment and perform internal split posting. A few operational notes:

- For EU/UK entries we need BrightPath's UK VAT ID (for invoicing) and the corresponding legal entity name exactly as registered.
- We will include per-line ledger tags (cost-center codes) and a reference column the customer can use on their payment file so our treasury team can auto-post.
- I attached our internal checklist with required fields (bank details only if BrightPath opts for separate remittances).

If BrightPath wants separate remittance destinations instead of a split-post, we will need to set up payment beneficiary references and test a wire. Consolidated ACH is preferred for faster reconciliation.

Attachments:
- entity_tax_ids.docx (DOCX)
